text: Artur Movsesyan is the founder of the Jogel brand; in 2010 he and his brother returned from their studies and immersed themselves in their father's sports-goods business.
short: Jogel founder Artur Movsesyan; family sports-goods business joined with his brother in 2010.

source.name: Metaratings.ru: «Одной из моих мечт было одевать сборную России» — интервью основателя Jögel Артура Мовсесяна
source.quote: В 2010 году, отучившись во французской бизнес-школе, мы с братом вернулись, началось наше погружение в бизнес отца
source.note: Translation: 'In 2010, having graduated from a French business school, my brother and I returned and immersed ourselves in our father's business.' The interview repeatedly calls Movsesyan 'основатель компании' (company founder).
